verification: ERA5 heavy-rain event at each location's 90th percentile

hypothesis.claim: A revision-aware material-change rule improves the precision/recall/lead-time trade-off versus fixed forecast thresholds.
hypothesis.product_update: Keep fixed thresholds as the alert gate. Use validated revision direction as an early-watch/context signal until an out-of-sample rule improves the full trade-off.

limitations: The heavy-rain threshold is defined from the evaluation period's observed climatology.
This evaluates heavy precipitation, not flood damage or human impact.
Three locations and roughly two months are not enough for a production alert policy.
